stone_cold.name: Hadrek Quarryborn
stone_cold.title: The Wall-Splitter
stone_cold.description: A quarry slave who broke a siege ram with a maul and was freed for it.
stone_cold.abilityDesc: Keystone Blow — bonus damage vs elites, brief pin.

the_rock.name: Osmar Tallgrave
the_rock.title: The Cairn-Maker
the_rock.description: Buries the men he beats under stones while the crowd keeps count.
the_rock.abilityDesc: Cairn Fall — smashes nearby foes on kill streak.

ric_flair.name: Lord Corvane Ashgilt
ric_flair.title: The Gilded Bastard
ric_flair.description: A disinherited lord who fights in his dead father's gilt mail.
ric_flair.abilityDesc: Herald's Boast — boosts ally morale in aura.

hulk_hogan.name: Brunhal Oxmantle
hulk_hogan.title: The Unfelled
hulk_hogan.description: Left for dead on three fields, and walked off every one of them.
hulk_hogan.abilityDesc: Stubborn Blood — heals when below 40% HP.

macho_man.name: Jorun Kestrelhand
macho_man.title: The Javelin of Spite
macho_man.description: Throws weighted javelins the way a hawk drops on a hare.
macho_man.abilityDesc: Stooping Cast — crit from high ground.

sting.name: Maldrick Sootgate
sting.title: The Gaoler
sting.description: A soot-black gaoler who has never lost a prisoner.

john_cena.name: Alder Wynfast
john_cena.title: The Oathkeeper
john_cena.description: Swore to hold a bridge for one night and held it for nine.
john_cena.abilityDesc: Sworn Stand — damage reduction under 50% HP.

bautista.name: Gorvan Hullbreaker
bautista.title: The Bull of Marrowgate
bautista.description: A drover's son who fights like the herd he grew up under.
bautista.abilityDesc: Goring Sweep — aoE slam on attack.

roman_reigns.name: Ulvar Deepmoor
roman_reigns.title: The Fen Warden
roman_reigns.description: Chief of a marsh clan; he goes in first and shields whoever follows.
roman_reigns.abilityDesc: Shoulder Ram — charge attack with knockback.

shawn_michaels.name: Sennet Quickheel
shawn_michaels.title: The Tourney Darling
shawn_michaels.description: A fairground tumbler turned duelist who ends fights with one kick.

bret_hart.name: Hestor Grindlaw
bret_hart.title: The Lockwright
bret_hart.description: A locksmith's apprentice who found every joint opens the same way.
bret_hart.abilityDesc: Lockwright's Hold — locks down one target.

undertaker.name: Brother Halvec
undertaker.title: The Bell of Low Hallow
undertaker.description: Tolls a hand-bell before he kills. Men have run from the sound alone.

kane.name: Varn Thistlehide
kane.title: The Troll-Flayer
kane.description: Wears a coat of troll quills and hunts things twice his size.
kane.abilityDesc: Barbed Hide — bonus vs larger foes.

andre_giant.name: Big Oddo of Cragfoot
andre_giant.title: The Walking Keep
andre_giant.description: A hill-giant's bastard, by his own telling. Nobody argues.

razor_ramon.name: Ilvane Whetstone
razor_ramon.title: The Patient Blade
razor_ramon.description: Sharpens his sword between every bout, and during some.

kevin_nash.name: Durgan Beamshoulder
kevin_nash.title: The Lintel
kevin_nash.description: A hod-carrier who drops men the way a roof drops its beams.
kevin_nash.abilityDesc: Roof Fall — heavy splash on every fourth blow.

roddy_piper.name: Fenrick Barbtongue
roddy_piper.title: The Heckler
roddy_piper.description: Insults his way into every fight and wins most of them.
roddy_piper.abilityDesc: Barbed Tongue — buffs allies when he scores.

hacksaw_duggan.name: Old Garth Bannerpole
hacksaw_duggan.title: The Colour-Serjeant
hacksaw_duggan.description: Carried a banner for thirty years and now fights with the pole.
hacksaw_duggan.abilityDesc: Raise the Colours — rally pulse on wave start.

junkyard_dog.name: Brask Ironbrow
junkyard_dog.title: The Ram of Tanner's Row
junkyard_dog.description: Settles arguments with his forehead. It has not lost one yet.

rey_mysterio.name: Pip Wrenfall
rey_mysterio.title: The Rope-Dancer
rey_mysterio.description: The smallest champion in the hall, and never yet held down.
rey_mysterio.abilityDesc: Rope-Dancer's Leap — evasion, hard to pin.

eddie_guerrero.name: Jessom Magpie
eddie_guerrero.title: The Light-Fingered
eddie_guerrero.description: Cheats at dice, cards and combat, and admits to all three.
eddie_guerrero.abilityDesc: Magpie's Due — steals TP on elite kill.

chris_benoit.name: Orrin Clampjaw
chris_benoit.title: The Vise
chris_benoit.description: Says nothing and lets go of nothing.

oba_femi.name: Tharn Ringholder
oba_femi.title: The Unbeaten Novice
oba_femi.description: The newest name on the hall's wall, and not yet crossed out.
oba_femi.abilityDesc: Ringed In — bonus damage when surrounded.

brock_lesnar.name: Gundrek Oxblood
brock_lesnar.title: The Butcher of the Bloodsand
brock_lesnar.description: A slaughterman who never changed trades, only what he works on.
brock_lesnar.abilityDesc: Carcass Throw — ends wounded targets outright.

cm_punk.name: Kerrin Ashvow
cm_punk.title: The Hedge-Preacher
cm_punk.description: A defrocked preacher who ends sermons and fights the same way.
cm_punk.abilityDesc: Last Word — finisher on low HP targets.

seth_rollins.name: Merrow Slingstone
seth_rollins.title: The Poacher
seth_rollins.description: Took the king's deer with a sling for ten years before the hall took him in.

sheamus.name: Hulder Rustbeard
sheamus.title: The Peat-Cutter
sheamus.description: Swings a peat spade wide enough for two.

bray_wyatt.name: Old Mother Sedge
bray_wyatt.title: The Bog Oracle
bray_wyatt.description: Reads deaths in marsh-light and is seldom wrong about them.
bray_wyatt.abilityDesc: Corpse-Candle Omen — fear aura blinds enemies; strongest when darkness falls.

randy_orton.name: Hallec Stillwater
randy_orton.title: The Still Hand
randy_orton.description: Stands so still the crowd forgets him. So do his opponents.
randy_orton.abilityDesc: Sudden Fall — strikes without warning; devastates wounded foes.
